justification: D-018c (with D-009#1, #5): errors are reported where they occur, without legacy's "return: " prefixes; legacy reports the enclosing `if`, `return` or index expression. The class rule classifies with the entry's own VM statistics and source (rt-diff --b-vm-stats) through vm_policies.classify: same stdout, one diagnostic each, equal messages after removing the prefixes, statistics locating the same error, the VM position verified against the source as the failing site and legacy's on the same line at or before it; no loop evidence.
test: tests/runtime2/vm_d018.py (old vs new); tests/runtime2/vm_policy_negative.py (synthetic bugs rejected)

justification: D-018c in code legacy runs on its loop evaluator (error_in_loop_path in the entry's own VM statistics): legacy's loop wording only as the canonical message's legacy form (same binding; an index error for "invalid index"; an element-assignment error for "invalid index target"), the VM position verified as the failing site and legacy's at the same line, a `while` statement or a statement with a call (outermost loop statement, caller's call site).
test: tests/runtime2/vm_d018.py (old vs new); tests/runtime2/vm_policy_negative.py (synthetic bugs rejected)

justification: D-018a: one number rule everywhere and exactly-once evaluation; legacy computes loop arithmetic in doubles and re-evaluates a loop statement whose value reaches 2^53. Approved per output line from the entry's own VM statistics (large_lines / derived_lines): number-only line changes on attributed lines (small numbers or booleans only where a large operand is attributed), adjacent repeated legacy lines at an attributed position, and legacy's continuation after an attributed overflow stop in loop code (vm_policies.numbers_match).
test: tests/runtime2/vm_d018.py (old vs new); tests/runtime2/vm_policy_negative.py (synthetic bugs rejected)
